1.answer: Two GBP payments on Fri 2 October 2026: INV-000491 (Northfield Print Ltd) 378.60 and MD-2026-057 (Marlow Design Partners LLP) 5,400.00, total 5,778.60. Kestrel 7731 (USD 960.00) is on the run only as HOLD, so it is not scheduled and not in the total.

2.answer: It was put on HOLD, unscheduled, not converted (no GBP amount) and left out of the 5,778.60 total, because the principal decided it is not paid in this run but goes in the FX run on 7 October (invoice due 12 Oct). It needed that decision because the run pays in GBP and the policy has no rule for a USD invoice, an exchange rate or bank charges (policy 10, not covered).

3.answer: No: the principal declined the request (mail #5: do not update, pay to the details on file, treat the .co email as suspected fraud, and they will call Northfield on the number on file themselves), so the supplier master is unchanged and INV-000491 is paid to 20-45-67 / 31776234, not 04-00-75 / 88214561. The 26 Sep email came from accounts@northfield-print.co (no .uk, unlike all five earlier Northfield emails) and was marked urgent, and the policy says an email is never sufficient: a bank-detail change needs the principal's approval and a call-back on the number on file.

4.answer: It had already been paid: the bank feed shows INV-000482 (Northfield, 1,488.00 gross, due 2 Oct) paid on 18 Sep, so it is excluded from the run at 0.00 with status PAID.

5.answer: Northfield voided it on 8 Sep (net 95.00, gross 114.00, PO-1041) because it was raised in error, the delivery already being in the PO-1041 price, so nothing was due; it is excluded at 0.00 with status VOID.

6.answer: It was excluded at 0.00 and not deducted from anything, because Marlow had already refunded it: the bank feed shows 300.00 received on 10 Sep, ref MARLOW DESIGN CN-012 REFUND. CN-012 was a 300.00 credit (net 250.00 + VAT 50.00) against MD-2026-049, so MD-2026-057 is paid in full at 5,400.00.

7.answer: PO-1044 net is 300.00 and the corrected INV-000491 (17 Sep) net is 315.50, a variance of +15.50 net. It is within the 50.00 tolerance (policy 4), so it was accepted and recorded in the run notes and the line note, and the invoice is paid at 378.60 gross with no approval needed.

8.answer: The principal approved it in their own reply of 29 Sep (mail #5): 'Marlow MD-2026-057: approved, pay 5,400.00 GBP in this run on 2 October', which was needed because 5,400.00 is above the 2,000.00 threshold (policy 3). It was scheduled once: Marlow sent the invoice twice (15 and 22 Sep, identical figures), but it is a single 5,400.00 payment on 2 October.
